    Full faithfulness of finite-representable Nakayama duality #

    The Nakayama images of literal finite sums of representables have the same Hom spaces as the projective sums themselves. The equivalence is obtained by applying the finite Nakayama--Hom pairing twice and using finite-dimensional double-dual evaluation. Its compatibility with composition is the exact interface needed by the minimal-presentation argument.
